description: Players on a team for one season: jersey, name, class year, positions, height and weight. Soft-deleted entries (duplicates and departed players the site hides) are excluded by default — a roster payload often carries substantially more rows than the page shows. Height and weight are null when the school did not publish them. Read-only.

includeDeleted.description: Include soft-deleted roster entries the site hides

season.description: Season label, e.g. 25-26. Omit for the current season.

team.description: Team site path or URL, e.g. nc/charlotte/myers-park-mustangs/football

name: maxpreps_get_roster
title: Get a MaxPreps team roster
